newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Foreign journalist detained in Singapore.
newsitem.headline: Foreign journalist detained in Singapore.

text.p: A journalist working for a U.S. news agency was detained in Singapore on Wednesday.

Eyewitnesses said the Associated Press (AP) Singapore news editor Vijay Joshi, an Indian national, was taken away in handcuffs by police after an argument on the sidelines of a joint news conference by British Foreign Secretary Malcolm Rifkind and Singapore Foreign Minister Shanmugam Jayakumar.
Asked if they were arresting Joshi, one policeman said: "Yes, we are."
A spokesman for the AP, Joe McDonald, said the agency had not been told if Joshi had been formally arrested. Comment ws not immediately available from a Singapore police spokesman.
Rifkind arrived in Singapore on Wednesday ahead of a series of meetings between ministers from Asia and the European Union.
Witnesses said there had been scuffles at the news conference as reporters tried to get past Singapore officials to reach the ministers.
Joshi was driven off in a police car, the witnesses added.
